chunks: We shall certainly meet you with like magic. So make an appointment when we and you could meet on common ground, which neither we nor you should fail to keep.

key_terms.لَا نُخْلِفُهُ: we do not fail to keep

ai.seo_question: What did the magicians of Pharaoh propose to Prophet Musa regarding their contest of magic?
ai.summary: In this verse, the magicians of Pharaoh challenge Musa (AS) to a public duel, setting a fixed time and place to prove their craft's superiority, which highlights the clash between established royal authority and divine truth. Shia scholarship often views this as a precursor to the ultimate victory of the Ahl al-Bayt over their enemies, where divine power ultimately prevails over worldly might. The specific promise of not breaking the appointment underscores the seriousness of the contest as a decisive test of prophetic authority.
